title: Motivational Seminar Speakers, 1970s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white 1970s snapshot featuring a woman at a microphone next to a smiling man during a motivational or personal development seminar. A banner behind them reads 'PERSONAL ACHIEVEMENT STEPPING STONES TO...', and a book display in front features a work co-authored by self-help pioneers Napoleon Hill and W. Clement Stone.
